items.title: Subnets Bleed as TAO Investors Retreat to Root
items.body: Bittensor’s subnet market extends its losses as investors shift capital to Root, while Engy defies the downturn with a 31.88% weekly rally.

items.title: Chutes (SN64) Partners With Global Giant Alibaba Cloud
items.body: Chutes partners with Alibaba Cloud to bring Qwen3.8 Max, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to its platform, with 35% off until Nov 23.

items.title: Taostats Launches Cross-Chain Swaps Between Ethereum and Bittensor
items.body: Learn how to use Taostats to swap ETH or USDC on Ethereum for TAO or Bittensor subnet tokens, and back again, without a separate bridge or exchange account.

items.title: Former CircuitHub Executive Oliver Williamson to Lead Growth at It’s AI (SN32)
items.body: It’s AI hires former CircuitHub executive Oliver Williamson as Head of Growth to grow sales and win new customers for its AI detector.

items.title: Lium Is a Monster Subnet, and It Will Not Stop Dominating
items.body: Lium continues to dominate Bittensor with $50 million in hosted GPU hardware, $2.93 million in monthly billings and 83% utilisation.

items.title: How Bittensor Miners Helped Build One of AI’s Best Decision Models
items.body: A month-old Bittensor subnet built one of the top AI decision models out of miner submissions. Here’s what REAX did and why the big labs should care.
